title: The Ultimate Gamble
next_chapter_hook: The Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor watched with a satisfied smile as Chen Ji's 'corpse' turned to ashes in the Dragon Vein explosion—but beneath that charred shell, what was the truth?

text.content: The Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor's footsteps echoed through the seventh level passage, each step like a war drum, shaking dust from the stone walls. Chen Ji held Chen Nian's hand, his knuckles white yet steady as bedrock. The Dragon Vein Core of the seventh level Forbidden Grounds was close at hand, azure-blue light flowing across the dome, casting Chen Ji's calm face in shifting illumination. He knew this was the final chess game of his life—win, and the siblings would part forever; lose, and it would be eternal doom.

dialogue.content: Nian Nian, listen to me. Three feet beneath the Dragon Vein Core lies a sealing rift, and that is the resonance point for the key within you. I will set up the 'Nirvana Fake Death Formation' there—when the formation activates, you must immediately trigger the Dragon Vein power to detonate the core—remember, not to destroy it, but to let it completely fuse with your bloodline.

text.content: Chen Nian's eyes trembled slightly, her tear-stained face revealing a trace of fear. She opened her mouth, wanting to say something, but was stopped by Chen Ji's gaze. There was not a hint of hesitation in those eyes, only the resolve to entrust everything to her. For twelve years, she had endlessly imagined reuniting with her brother in the Holy Sect's prison, but she never imagined the cost of reunion would be watching him fight with his life on the line.

dialogue.content: Brother...are you sure? Once that formation starts, even the Tianji Record cannot窥探 my生死. I'm...I'm afraid...

choice.prompt: The Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor's footsteps grow closer, Chen Ji must complete the arrangement in limited time—how will he convey his final trust to Chen Nian?

choices.text: Vow in the name of a brother
choices.description: Chen Ji pressed his forehead against Chen Nian's, swearing with blood that he would reunite with her after this battle. Regardless of life or death, this bond would never sever.
choices.visible_reward: Chen Nian gains the 'Bloodline Resonance' state, protecting her from backlash during Dragon Vein fusion
choices.risk_hint: Chen Ji, whose Heavenly Fate was already precious, will consume key resources with this action
choices.process_label: 陈机额头抵住陈念额头，低声起誓

dialogue.content: I, Chen Ji, swear with my blood that after this battle, regardless of where I am or whether I survive, I will reunite with you. If I break this vow, may Heaven abandon me.

text.content: A drop of essence blood seeped from Chen Ji's fingertip, landing on Chen Nian's brow center, transforming into a pale golden mark. That mark flashed and vanished, yet it let Chen Nian feel an unprecedented warmth—the temperature of her brother's blood, the weight of twelve years of longing.

choices.text: Persuade her as an利益共同体
choices.description: Chen Ji calmly analyzed the situation: only by faking his death and escaping could Chen Nian rightfully obtain the Dragon Vein's recognition, and only then could both of them truly escape the chess game.
choices.visible_reward: Chen Nian gains the 'Rational Awakening' state, becoming more calm and precise when executing the plan
choices.risk_hint: Lacking emotional bonds may cause hesitation during execution
choices.process_label: 陈机以谋士的口吻快速分析局势

dialogue.content: Nian Nian, you are the Dragon Vein key, and I am the Tianji Record Fragment. We are the core chess pieces of this game—but if I die, you will no longer be a piece, but a variable. Variables are the only way to break the board.

text.content: A spark of understanding flashed in Chen Nian's eyes. Twelve years of captivity taught her to endure, but never to play with fate as her brother did. She took a deep breath and nodded firmly.

The footsteps suddenly accelerated. Dozens of formation flags flew from Chen Ji's sleeve, sketching intricate patterns around the Dragon Vein Core. That was the core formation eye of the 'Nirvana Fake Death Formation'—using the power of the Tianji Record Fragment as a guide, completely erasing the user's aura from the world. A cold smile curved his lips: the Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor wanted to see him die? Then he would let him see enough.

dialogue.content: Brother, the formation flags are set...I can sense the Dragon Vein Core, it's calling to me.

text.content: Chen Ji猛然抬头. The stone door at the entrance of the seventh level exploded, and amidst the漫天 dust, a figure stood against the light. The Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor wore a玄黑 official robe, his face serene as an ancient well, only the playful smile at the corner of his lips revealing居高临下的傲慢. His gaze swept over Chen Ji and Chen Nian, falling on the Dragon Vein Core, as if viewing two cornered beasts.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, this seat thought you would flee. Unexpected—the堂堂 Tianji inheritor actually愚蠢到在这绝地等死?

choice.prompt: The Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor appears, Chen Ji's plan has no retreat—how should he face this final moment?

choices.text: Provocation: luring the enemy into a trap
choices.description: Chen Ji冷笑出声, mocking that the Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor was merely a pawn on Heaven's chessboard, knowing nothing about why he was here. Luring the enemy into the formation's core, buying time for Chen Nian to start.
choices.visible_cost: Completely reveals that Chen Ji had premeditated plans
choices.visible_reward: The Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor was enraged, entering the formation range, Chen Nian gains complete activation time
choices.risk_hint: Provoking a powerful enemy may trigger uncontrollable variables
choices.process_label: 陈机以嘲讽之态激怒太子太师

dialogue.content: A pawn终究是 a pawn. You think you are a棋手? No, you don't even know what this chess game looks like. Come, let me teach you what real布局 means.

text.content: The Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor's face阴沉, killing intent沸腾 in his eyes. He waved his sleeve, overwhelming pressure like a mountain collapsing, transforming into a black light rushing straight at Chen Ji—directly falling into the formation's core range.

choices.text: Feigning weakness: enticing the enemy deeper
choices.description: Chen Ji pretended to be terrified, pulling Chen Nian toward the Dragon Vein Core, assuming the posture of a cornered beast. Secretly letting Chen Nian quietly activate the key, waiting for the optimal moment.
choices.visible_cost: Chen Nian must split her attention to activate, which may expose the intention
choices.visible_reward: The Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor relaxes his guard, Chen Ji gains a more从容 activation timing
choices.risk_hint: If the acting is exposed, it will lead to a desperate situation
choices.process_label: 陈机以惊恐之态掩饰真正意图

dialogue.content: T-Tai Shi大人...I only accidentally entered this place, absolutely no offense intended! I beg your forgiveness, spare my brother and me a way out!

text.content: Chen Ji quietly pushed Chen Nian's hand behind her back, quickly tracing a rune on her palm with his fingertip. Chen Nian understood implicitly, her lowered sleeve covering her faintly glowing left hand. The Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor narrowed his eyes, seemingly savoring the prey's despair.

Chen Ji slowly raised his hand, an ancient fragment materializing in his palm. The aura of the Tianji Record was completely released at this moment, resonating with the Dragon Vein Core. The entire seventh level space began to distort, golden cracks mingling with the azure-blue light, as if the heavens themselves were tearing apart. The Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor's expression slightly changed, yet he did not retreat—he thought this was merely a cornered beast's last struggle.

dialogue.content: Tai Shi大人, do you want to know why I chose this place? Because this is...the only corner of this heaven and earth not watched by Heaven's Eye.

text.content: The words fell, the formation rose. The patterns beneath Chen Ji's feet blazed brilliantly, golden-red flames erupting from the earth's depths, engulfing his entire body. At the same time, Chen Nian let out a clear cry toward the sky, her internal Dragon Vein key completely awakening—a brilliant pillar of light erupted from her crown, shooting directly into the Dragon Vein Core.

choice.prompt: The Dragon Vein explosion is imminent, Chen Ji's fake death formation has already activated—at this final moment, what is on his mind?

choices.description: Chen Ji looked back at Chen Nian in the flames, conveying his final entrustment through his eyes: Live, grow stronger, then see for me what this Heaven's design truly is.
choices.visible_cost: Consciousness completely sleeps during fake death
choices.visible_reward: Chen Nian gains the 'Brother's遗志' permanent BUFF, Combat Power +20%, greatly improved perception of Heaven's Eye
choices.risk_hint: Completely loses mobility during fake death
choices.process_label: 陈机在烈焰中最后望向陈念

text.content: As the flames burned his body, Chen Ji saw Chen Nian's figure desperately channeling the Dragon Vein power. He silently recited: Nian Nian, from now on, you are no longer anyone's chess piece. You are your own chess player.

choices.text: 无声的 taunt toward the Grand Preceptor
choices.description: Chen Ji勾起嘴角 in the flames, mouthing four words to the Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor: You lost. In the enemy's horrified gaze, the Nirvana flames consumed everything.
choices.visible_reward: The Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor falls into self-doubt, 'Heart Demon' seed planted, subsequent plot trigger points unlocked
choices.risk_hint: Excessive provocation may provoke the other party into irrational behavior
choices.process_label: 陈机以口型无声嘲讽太子太师

text.content: Chen Ji opened his mouth, silently forming four words. The Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor's pupils contracted sharply—those were 'You lost.' He tried to stop it, but discovered the Dragon Vein power had completely locked down the entire space. He could only watch helplessly as that figure turned to ash in the golden-red flames.

The Dragon Vein Core exploded. The terrifying temporal-spatial rift, like a primordial beast's gaping mouth, devoured the entire seventh level. The Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor was hurled back several zhang by the shockwave, his sleeves shattered, utterly disheveled. And before his eyes, Chen Ji's figure had completely vanished in the golden-red flames, not even a trace of residue remaining.

The Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor slowly stood up, dust-covered yet unable to hide the得意 in his eyes. He仰天大笑, laughter echoing in the collapsing space: 'Tianji inheritor?不过如此! Calculated to the end,终究难逃一死! Ha ha ha ha—' His laughter stopped abruptly. Because he saw Chen Nian—that maiden who should have been devoured by the temporal-spatial rift, standing unharmed in the center of the light pillar, gazing at him.

Chen Nian's eyes no longer held any trace of the timidity from before, replaced by a coldness beyond her years. Her body circulated Dragon Vein energy, fusing with the core as if she was the true master of this heaven and earth. The Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor's heart skipped a beat, an ominous premonition rising in his mind—he seemed to have miscalculated something. But when he surveyed the surroundings again, confirming Chen Ji was truly dead, that unease was again washed away by satisfaction. He thought: Chen Ji is dead, that genius threatening his position finally no longer exists. And the 'death' he witnessed will become capital for his future achievements. The Crown Prince's Grand Preceptor straightened his残破的 robes, a satisfied smile spreading across his face. What he didn't know was that beneath that turned-to-ashes body, the true Chen Ji had long since escaped this world through the Nirvana Fake Death Formation. His victory was merely the beginning of another chess game.
